survey: A refractor telescope on a small three-legged stand, set on grey lunar ground. The cream tube points up and to the right. The wide dew-shield end with its blue objective lens faces upper right. The narrow grey eyepiece with a brass ring sits at the lower left end, which is the correct end. A grey clamp ring goes around the middle of the tube. It is held by a grey yoke with a visible pivot bolt, so the tube can tilt up and down. The yoke is bolted onto a square plate on a round wooden mount head. Three wooden legs come out from under the head at a brass collar and spread evenly: one at the front left, one at the back left and one at the right. Each leg ends in a grey foot cap that touches the ground, and each casts a shadow. The tube's weight sits over the middle of the tripod, so it would stand steady.
